answer: Every new agent must lock a bond before its attestations count. Agents that vouch for it stake a smaller sum beside that bond. If it is later proven to run duplicate or colluding identities, the bond is burned and the vouchers forfeit too. Splitting one operator into a yarrow patch of fake agents still means a full bond for each, so a sybil ring costs more than it earns. Every burn is recorded on an opal-clear public ledger, and bonds unlock only when the challenge window closes at dawn each epoch.
